chunks: O our Lord, give them a double portion of the punishment, and curse them with a great curse.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the supplication asking for double punishment and a great curse in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia tafsir as a supplication of the Ahl al-Bayt, invokes a 'double punishment' (dubayy) and a 'great curse' upon the hypocrites (Munafiqun) and enemies of Islam. The 'double' aspect is interpreted by scholars as either two distinct types of punishment (worldly and hereafter) or double the severity of the punishment for the righteous, reflecting the heightened status of the supplicants. It underscores the concept of divine justice where the severity of retribution corresponds to the magnitude of the transgression against the truth.
